Key points
• The most possible mechanism for sarcopenia is the defect of protein degradation through autophagy-lysosome signaling.
• Milder CR (15–25%) would also be effective for age-related muscle atrophy in humans.
• Many supplemental candidates for possible combating sarcopenia is needed systematic and fundamental research using
rodent models of sarcopenia.
